description: Defines the class 'hostIf_WiFi_SSID' which provides APIs for managing WiFi SSID configurations, including getters and setters for SSID properties, and references external WiFi-related headers.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_SSID
classes.description: A class providing APIs to access and modify WiFi SSID parameters such as Enable, Status, Alias, Name, LastChange, LowerLayers, BSSID, MACAddress, SSID, BSSID, MACAddress, and SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable/disable status of the SSID entry.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable/disable status of the SSID entry.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the operational status of the SSID entry.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of the SSID.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of the SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_Name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the SSID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_LastChange
methods.description: Retrieves the time since the SSID last changed state.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_LowerLayers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of lower layer interfaces.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_SSID_LowerLayers
methods.description: Sets the list of lower layer interfaces.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_BSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the BSSID (MAC address of access point).

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_SSID_MACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the interface.
